questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When your left arm is extended straight out, it tells other drivers you are turning left or changing lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep or long downgrade or hill is ahead. The road may have sharp curves as well.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign means a railroad crossing is coming. Slow down, look and listen for trains, and be ready to stop. Do not cross until any trains have passed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An octagonal (eight-sided) sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop, yield to other traffic and pedestrians, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop if needed. Let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. It shows rules you must follow. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black text on yellow. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns of a steep hill coming. Adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive with extra care in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow pennant-shaped signs mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make U-turns. You will often see this sign at intersections with heavy oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare drivers for hazards. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid accidents.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic may enter from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
questions.explanation: At railroad crossings, look and listen carefully. Slow down and be ready to stop. Only cross after any trains have passed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign means a divided highway is starting. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign shows parking spaces reserved for people with disabilities. These spaces are for vehicles with disability license plates, disabled veteran plates, or disability placards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection. It is unsafe and against the law to turn right here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you about a road with three or more curves coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Wet roads are slippery and dangerous. This sign warns of conditions that make you lose control of your vehicle. Slow down on wet pavement because it takes longer to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a yield sign is coming up. Start to slow down when you see this warning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare you for road hazards. This sign warns you about a winding road ahead. Adjust your speed accordingly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a divided highway is coming up.
